name: BLOOD ANGELS: ASTORATH THE GRIM
description: Astorath the Grim goes wherever the sons of Sanguinius are on the cusp of the Black Rage. Determined to give those warriors a glorious final victory, he fights like a man possessed, lopping off the heads of his enemies while leading frothing Space Marines consumed with unrestrained fury.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Astorath the Grim, a leader whose sole purpose is to throw himself into the thickest melee alongside his brothers who have succumbed to the Black Rage. Wielding no ranged weapons at all, and equipped with a jump pack, he bounds forward in blind fury, reaping a heavy toll with his instantly-recognisable Executioner's Axe, resplendent in his flayed-skin-look power armour – he is the very vision of the Blood Angels at their most savage.</br></br>This kit contains 17 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 40mm Round Base. This miniature is supplied unassembled and unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
